data.name: Narayani
data.gender_notes: Narayani is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Narayani is the name of the goddess who is the consort of Vishnu, the preserver god in Hindu mythology. She is also known as Vishnu's shakti, or divine energy. The name Narayani comes from the word 'Narayana', which means 'the one who rests in water'. As the goddess of Gods, Narayani is the embodiment of compassion, love, and nurturing energy.
data.etymology: Narayani belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Gods.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Narayani total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
